title: Nik's CE Pack
description: A texture pack for custom enchantments on LifeSteal.net (LSN)
body:
## About
Custom texture pack for the public LifeSteal server.

The pack changes the textures of most tools and armor that have custom enchantments, including textures for other unique items found on the server.

The textures included apply for items like tools, bows, tridents, shields, spears and armor, along with textures for enchanted book rarities, ender paper, hearts, etc. It also includes textures for most of, if not all the spawners and keys found on the LifeSteal server. 

The pack will be regurarly updated with new additions!

## Normal vs. Vanilla version
There are two seperate versions to this pack - a **vanilla** and a **normal** version. The vanilla version uses vanilla-based armor textures, meanwhile the normal version has armor textures similar to the original hoarder pack. The comparison can be found in the image gallery on this page. These versions also have two different variants, one with all trims visible, and the other with no trims visible except for netherite.

## Requirements
Requires version **5.4.1** of [Variants-CIT](https://modrinth.com/mod/variants-cit) to have the benefit of all the features of the pack. 

Alternatively - As Variants CIT overwrites the shield model with the vanilla one, I have decided to make a fork of the mod that includes a lower shield model, this is and will only be available on [my Github page](https://github.com/Nik-T-7/mc-Variants-CIT). It's open source and you can download it from the actions or the releases tab. _1.21.9 is the version for 1.21.11_

If you don't want to download the mod from Github but still want lower shields, you can use lower shield mods that change the shield model. One example is BactroMod.

Do not download random mods and/or files from other people! Be safe!
